svg.title: Logbook: experience
svg.desc: JUN 2025 To Aug 2025. AI/ML & Software Engineering Intern, Bharat Electronics Limited. Built a FAISS-backed retrieval pipeline on Llama 3.2 Vision over 100+ page internal documents, taking lookups for 50+ staff from hours to under 10 seconds. Scripted RHEL 9 environment setup, cutting per-machine provisioning from 3 hours to 15 minutes. Shipped a one-click installer so non-technical staff could set the system up on-prem. MAR 2026 To Present. Secretary, IEEE Computer Society (UPES).
